faqs.q: How does TechPros ensure our website is fast and fully SEO optimized?
faqs.a: We build our web applications using lightweight, clean-coded architectures (Next.js, modern PHP, Tailwind CSS) with built-in Schema.org JSON-LD structured data, automatic XML sitemaps, Open Graph metadata, semantic HTML5 hierarchy, and CDN caching to guarantee 95+ Google PageSpeed and sub-second Core Web Vitals.

faqs.q: What security measures are implemented in your web development projects?
faqs.a: Security is integrated at every tier. We enforce OWASP Top 10 mitigation, strict HTTP security headers (CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options), rate-limiting against DDoS and brute force, prepared database statements against SQLi, input sanitization against XSS, and end-to-end SSL/TLS encryption.

faqs.q: Can you integrate custom APIs, ERPs, CRMs, or legacy systems?
faqs.a: Yes. We build custom REST and GraphQL API gateways, webhook listeners, and background sync workers that seamlessly connect your web application to Salesforce, HubSpot, SAP, custom internal databases, and third-party payment gateways.

faqs.q: Where is your development and support team located?
faqs.a: Our core engineering headquarters and Network Operations Center (NOC) is located in Sector 62, Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India, with 24/7 global delivery capabilities supporting clients worldwide.
